indicator_description: Concentration of fine particles in the air. Fine particles are emitted by vehicles, building boilers, and other combustion — and are a major form of air pollution that harms health. Neighborhood sensors measure PM2.5 at the street-level, where people are most active. These sensors are designed to let us measure differences in air pollution over time and locations within New York City.
data_source_list: New York City Community Air Survey

indicator_description: Concentration of fine particles in the air. Fine particles are emitted by vehicles, building boilers, and other combustion — and are a major form of air pollution that harms health. Neighborhood sensors measure PM2.5 at the street-level, where people are most active. These sensors are designed to let us measure differences in air pollution over time and locations within New York City.
data_source_list: New York City Community Air Survey
